detail.longDescription:
It is a lightweight application with simple operation and easy to get started with.
PDF files are automatically searched and displayed on mobile phones, facilitating unified management and quick opening for reading, allowing you to enjoy a convenient reading experience.
It has very rich functions and is compatible with multiple file formats. The files, pictures and tables are all fine.
File preview
Automatically identify and display all documents in the device, presenting the document content smoothly.
Supports switching between different scrolling modes to view PDF documents, with smooth page turning, clear display of text and images, and easy viewing of content details.
Convert the image to PDF format
Supports image conversion to PDF format, automatically optimizes layout, and can be generated with one click, facilitating file management and sharing.
A powerful PDF manager
Display all the most recent files in the order they were most recently opened for quick access.
Files can be deleted and set as collected files.
Conveniently share collaborative files with others.
Quickly print PDF files from your mobile phone.
License Statement
Our application needs to invoke the following MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permissions to implement the following important functions.
File search and display: Scan and recognize PDF documents stored in the device, present a complete list of documents, and facilitate users' search and opening of the required files.
File classification management: Classify PDF files based on information such as file names and creation dates, making it convenient for users to manage a large number of documents.
Ensure smooth reading: When opening complex PDF files, it is necessary to keep running in the background to avoid interruptions and enhance the reading experience.
We are well aware of the significance of user privacy and data security, and will only use this permission with the user's explicit consent.
Learn more
Privacy policy: https://bibleinsightpro.com/1/privacy/
